canonical.title: Day-trips within 30 km of Moor Hall

parent.title: Weekend at Moor Hall: lodging, day-trips and tech detours within 30 km of Aughton

siblings.title: Walking-distance lodging at or near Moor Hall
siblings.summary: Only Moor Hall itself is true walking distance; the next-closest hotels are 1.4–1.6 mi rural-road walks better done as a £5 taxi.

siblings.title: Special-character lodging within taxi range of Moor Hall
siblings.summary: Eight character-led places to stay within a short taxi ride of three-Michelin-starred Moor Hall, Aughton — from on-site rooms to 17th-c manors and a hot-tub yurt.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events within 30 km of Moor Hall
siblings.summary: Tech-event calendar within a 30 km circle of Moor Hall — Liverpool dominates, Manchester sits just outside the radius.

sources.title: https://www.nationaltrust.org.uk/visit/liverpool-lancashire/formby
sources.claim: Formby (National Trust) car parks at Lifeboat Road and Victoria Road open 09:00-17:00, parking £9 (free for NT members and blue badge); beach is open all day; dogs welcome.

sources.title: https://www.sefton.gov.uk/around-sefton/another-place-by-antony-gormley/plan-your-visit/
sources.claim: Crosby Beach's 'Another Place' is best visited with the tide times in mind; the nearest car parks are at Hall Road (L23 8SY), Mariners Road and Cambridge Road, and Merseyrail runs trains every ~15 minutes to Hall Road/Blundellsands/Waterloo.

sources.title: https://www.sefton.gov.uk/around-sefton/parks-and-greenspaces/crosby-coastal-park/
sources.claim: Crosby Coastal Park surrounds the Gormley sculptures with a marine lake, formal gardens, playground and the start of the 22-mile Sefton Coastal Path, with strong bird life and watersports.

sources.title: https://www.sefton.gov.uk/around-sefton/coast-and-countryside/explore-our-nature-reserves/ainsdale-and-birkdale-sandhills-nature-reserve/
sources.claim: Ainsdale & Birkdale Sandhills (988 ha) is one of Britain's largest wild dune areas, famous for natterjack toads ('Birkdale Nightingale'), sand lizards and great crested newts; parking at Ainsdale Discovery Centre.

sources.title: https://www.woodlandtrust.org.uk/visiting-woods/woods/ainsdale-sand-dunes-nnr/
sources.claim: Ainsdale Sand Dunes NNR has ~8 miles of way-marked footpaths; the Woodland Path and Fisherman's Path are wheelchair/pushchair/cycle accessible; reachable on foot from Ainsdale or Freshfield rail stations.

sources.title: https://www.lancswt.org.uk/nature-reserves/mere-sands-wood-nature-reserve
sources.claim: Mere Sands Wood (Rufford) is a 42-ha Lancashire Wildlife Trust reserve with six accessible hides, 170+ recorded bird species, red squirrels and ~95% wheelchair-accessible paths; visitor centre/cafe open Wed-Sun 10:00-16:00; £4 car park.

sources.title: https://www.wwt.org.uk/wetland-centres/martin-mere/plan-your-visit/opening-times
sources.claim: WWT Martin Mere (Burscough, ~10 km from Aughton) opens 09:30-18:00 in summer (last entry 17:00) with free on-site parking; activities include canoe safaris, pond dipping and adventure play.

sources.title: https://www.westlancs.gov.uk/leisure-recreation/parks-and-countryside/parks-and-countryside-sites/beacon-country-park-up-holland.aspx
sources.claim: Beacon Country Park (Up Holland) covers 300+ acres of meadow, woodland and ponds with free parking, café, orienteering course and a Tramper off-road mobility scooter for hire.

sources.title: https://liverpool.gov.uk/parks-and-greenspaces/explore-our-parks/croxteth-country-park/
sources.claim: Croxteth Country Park has a free car park (locked overnight) and includes Croxteth Home Farm with rare breeds, a miniature railway, parkrun routes and Grade II* Croxteth Hall.

sources.title: https://www.rivingtonterracedgardens.org.uk/what-to-see-and-do/places-to-park-eat-and-stay/
sources.claim: Rivington Terraced Gardens / Lever Park (borderline ~30 km east) offer four free car parks (Lower House nearest to the gardens, ~80 cars), with on-site cafés including Great House Barn and The Café at Spring Cottage.

sources.title: https://www.lancswt.org.uk/parking
sources.claim: Mere Sands Wood car park is open 24 hours with a £4 charge; payment by cash (coins), card, contactless or RingGo code 25807.

sources.title: https://www.nationaltrust.org.uk/visit/liverpool-lancashire/rufford-old-hall
sources.claim: Rufford Old Hall (NT) opens house 11:00–16:30 and garden/tea-room 10:30–16:30 on a typical late-May Saturday; adult admission £13.00.

sources.title: https://www.nationaltrust.org.uk/visit/liverpool-lancashire/speke-hall
sources.claim: Speke Hall's Tudor mansion is closed on Saturdays in 2026; only the gardens (10:00–17:00) and restaurant (10:00–16:30) are open Saturday, so it is a grounds-only pick on a Moor-Hall dinner day.

sources.title: https://meolshall.co.uk/meolshall-open/
sources.claim: Meols Hall (Churchtown, Southport) opens to the public only on May Bank Holiday Mondays and late-August through 25 September daily 13:30–17:30 — so it is NOT visitable on a typical Saturday.

sources.title: https://whichmuseum.com/museum/croxteth-hall-and-country-park-liverpool-4346/opening-hours
sources.claim: Croxteth Hall and Walled Garden open daily 10:30–17:00 from 24 March to 30 September; the surrounding country park stays open 07:00–19:00 in summer — easy mid-afternoon stop before driving back to Aughton.

sources.title: https://astleypark.co.uk/
sources.claim: Astley Hall in Chorley reopens 5 April 2026 with free entry while West Wing restoration continues; only east-wing ground-floor rooms accessible until late July 2026, after which opening expands Tuesday–Sunday.

sources.title: https://www.hoghtontower.co.uk/visit/opening-times-tours-prices/
sources.claim: Hoghton Tower offers self-guided Saturday house and garden access 11:00–16:00 (last entry 15:30) from 4 April to 3 October 2026 — workable but borderline 30 km and several Saturdays are closed for events.

sources.title: https://palmhouse.org.uk/visiting-us/
sources.claim: Sefton Park Palm House (Liverpool) is a free Victorian glasshouse open daily 10:30–18:30 in summer — a long-window, low-commitment heritage stop that easily fits before a 19:00 Moor Hall slot.

sources.title: https://www.scarisbrickhalltrust.org/visit-us
sources.claim: Scarisbrick Hall (Pugin Gothic Revival, A570 between Ormskirk and Southport) is a school today and only opens for two booked public days in 2026 — 20 August and 23 October — so it is not a generic Saturday option.

sources.title: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Burscough_Priory
sources.claim: Burscough Priory is an Augustinian ruin founded c.1190, dissolved 1536; only two crossing piers and chancel-wall stumps remain, freely accessible as a Scheduled Ancient Monument — a 15-minute drive-by stop, not a half-day.

sources.title: https://www.lythamhall.org.uk/openingtimes
sources.claim: Lytham Hall (Georgian, Fylde coast) opens parkland daily 10:00–16:30 and the Georgian Hall 12:00–16:00 (last entry 15:00); pay on the door — sits at the outer edge of the 30 km radius.

sources.title: https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/walker-art-gallery
sources.claim: Walker Art Gallery in Liverpool city centre opens Saturday 10:00–17:00 with free admission — a strong wet-weather plan B inside the 30 km radius.

sources.title: https://albertdock.com/
sources.claim: Royal Albert Dock is a free open-air heritage waterfront in Liverpool, the most-visited free attraction in North West England, with bars, restaurants and museums clustered around the historic basin.

sources.title: https://www.tate.org.uk/visit/tate-liverpool
sources.claim: Tate Liverpool's Albert Dock building is closed for redevelopment; the gallery is operating from a temporary home at RIBA North, Mann Island, free entry, open 10:00-17:50.

sources.title: https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/visit
sources.claim: National Museums Liverpool venues (Museum of Liverpool, Walker Art Gallery, World Museum) are open Tuesday-Sunday 10:00-17:00 with free admission.

sources.title: https://www.liverpoolmuseums.org.uk/news/press-releases/last-chance-visit-international-slavery-museum-and-maritime-museum-temporary-0
sources.claim: Both the International Slavery Museum and Merseyside Maritime Museum closed in January 2025 for redevelopment and are due to reopen in 2028 — not available for a 2026 visit.

sources.title: https://www.beatlesstory.com/plan-your-visit/opening-times/
sources.claim: The Beatles Story at Royal Albert Dock opens Saturday 09:00-18:30 (last entry 17:15), Sun-Fri 09:00-17:30.

sources.title: https://www.beatlesstory.com/plan-your-visit/prices/
sources.claim: Beatles Story admission is £20 adult, £16 concession, £11 child (5-15), under-5s free; ticket includes multilingual audio guide.

sources.title: https://www.cavernclub.com/opening-times-and-prices/
sources.claim: The Cavern Club on Mathew Street is open 11:00-02:00 Friday & Saturday with single entry £6 or all-day pass £8.50, cashless only.

sources.title: https://liverpoolcathedral.org.uk/plan-your-visit/opening-hours/
sources.claim: Liverpool Cathedral (Anglican) is open Saturday 10:00-18:00 with the Tower Experience available 10:00-16:30 last entry; building entry is free.

sources.title: https://liverpoolmetrocathedral.org.uk/visit-us/
sources.claim: The Metropolitan Cathedral of Christ the King is open daily 07:30-18:00 with free admission; Lutyens Crypt is open Mon-Sat 10:00-16:00 (last entry 15:30).

sources.title: https://www.britishmusicexperience.com/plan-your-visit
sources.claim: The British Music Experience in the Cunard Building (Pier Head) is open Wed-Sun 10:00-17:00 (last entry 15:45); admission £21 walk-up / £19 pre-booked online for adults.

sources.title: https://www.liverpool-one.com/opening-times/
sources.claim: Liverpool ONE shopping district opens 09:00-19:00 on Saturdays; the on-site car parks total around 3,000 spaces with tariffs from ~£3.30/hour and £22/24hr, with a 15% discount via the LIVONE promo code.

sources.title: https://www.merseyferries.co.uk/timetables/
sources.claim: Mersey Ferries' 50-minute River Explorer Cruise from Pier Head runs hourly on Saturdays with the last boat departing Seacombe at 16:00 (Liverpool side ~20 past the hour).

sources.title: https://www.rome2rio.com/s/Aughton/Liverpool
sources.claim: Driving from Aughton to central Liverpool covers about 10 miles and takes roughly 19 minutes in typical traffic via the A59/M58.

sources.title: https://www.merseyrail.org/journey-planning/stations/town-green/
sources.claim: Town Green station is on the Merseyrail Northern Line with direct services to Liverpool Central via Ormskirk branch trains.

sources.title: https://www.thetrainline.com/train-times/aughton-park-to-liverpool
sources.claim: Trains from Aughton Park / Town Green to Liverpool Central run roughly every 15 minutes on the Merseyrail Ormskirk-Liverpool branch with a journey time around 30-35 minutes; advance fares from ~£8.79.

sources.title: https://www.sefton.gov.uk/mysefton-news/latest-news/southport-pier-repair-works-set-to-begin-in-early-2026-council-announces/
sources.claim: Southport Pier has been closed since December 2022 and repair works are expected to begin in early 2026, taking approximately 14 months — so it will be closed throughout a May 2026 visit.

sources.title: https://lbndaily.co.uk/government-confirms-20m-to-reopen-southport-pier/
sources.claim: A £20m UK Government Growth Mission Fund award unlocked the full restoration of the Grade II-listed Southport Pier in 2026.

sources.title: https://www.visitsouthport.com/things-to-do/attractions/parks-gardens/
sources.claim: Southport's Victorian Botanic Gardens north of the centre have an 1874 glasshouse, lake and flowerbeds; nearby Hesketh Park (Edward Kemp, 1860s) sits at the north end of Lord Street with themed gardens, fountains and a lake.

sources.title: https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hesketh_Park,_Southport
sources.claim: Hesketh Park is a Victorian public park designed by Edward Kemp in the mid-19th century, situated near the north end of Lord Street.

sources.title: https://eyeonsouthport.co.uk/southport-unveils-ambitious-cultural-events-for-2026
sources.claim: Southport is hosting its first-ever Year of Culture in 2026 with major headline events including Lightport (Feb), the Big Top Festival (May) and Books Alive! (Oct), making 2026 an unusually rich year to visit.

sources.title: https://www.adventurecoastsouthport.co.uk/your-visit/opening-times/
sources.claim: Southport Pleasureland has been rebranded as Adventure Coast Southport, with free park entry and weekend/school-holiday operation 11am–5pm; rides are paid via a £36 unlimited wristband or a £2 top-up Fun Card.

sources.title: https://www.visitsouthport.com/listing/southport-marine-lake/5700201/
sources.claim: Southport's 140-acre Marine Lake offers boating, pedalos, motor boats and landscaped promenade walks, originally built in the 19th century as a low-tide haven for vessels.

sources.title: https://theatkinson.co.uk/exhibition/20-years-of-another-place/
sources.claim: The Atkinson in Southport is currently free to enter and runs the '20 Years of Another Place' photography exhibition (Ron Davies' shots of the Gormley figures) — a thematic tie-in for visitors combining Southport culture with a Crosby Beach trip.

sources.title: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Another_Place_(sculpture)
sources.claim: Crosby Beach's 'Another Place' consists of 100 cast-iron, life-size Gormley body-casts spread across 3 km of foreshore and almost 1 km out to sea — each 189 cm tall and ~650 kg.

sources.title: https://www.visitliverpool.com/listing/another-place-by-antony-gormley-at-crosby-beach/16098101/
sources.claim: Crosby is a non-bathing beach with soft sand, mud and tide risk; visitors must stay within 50 m of the promenade and time visits to low tide.

sources.title: https://www.nationaltrust.org.uk/formby/trails/formby-red-squirrel-walk
sources.claim: Formby sits within the North Merseyside/West Lancashire red squirrel stronghold — one of only a few UK refuges — with pine woods backing onto the dunes and beach.

sources.title: https://www.formbyguide.co.uk/formby-beach
sources.claim: Formby's Victoria Road car park and toilets are closed until spring 2026 for a major conservation project, so visitors must use the Lifeboat Road entrance (free Blue Badge spaces) or arrive by train.

sources.title: https://tailblazr.com/north-west/beaches/formby-beach/
sources.claim: Formby Beach is dog-friendly year-round with no seasonal ban, but dogs must be leashed near the dunes to protect natterjacks and ground-nesting birds.

sources.title: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/merseysides-national-nature-reserves/merseysides-national-nature-reserves
sources.claim: Ainsdale Sand Dunes NNR is one of the best remaining UK strongholds of the rare natterjack toad, with the Sefton Coast holding ~40% of the UK population.

sources.title: https://www.rome2rio.com/s/Aughton/Southport
sources.claim: Aughton to Southport is roughly 11 miles / ~17 minutes by car — comfortably within a 30 km radius of Moor Hall.

sources.title: https://ukdistance.com/route/ormskirk/lytham-st-annes
sources.claim: Lytham St Annes is ~30 miles / 29.7 mi by road from Ormskirk (Aughton sits next door), pushing it well over a 30 km radius — borderline-out for this trip.

sources.title: https://www.placenorthwest.co.uk/vinci-to-deliver-73m-marine-lake-events-centre/
sources.claim: The £73m+ Marine Lake Events Centre (1,200-seat theatre, 2,400-capacity conference space) is under construction with main works expected to start later in 2026, meaning visitors will see hoardings around part of the lakefront.

sources.title: https://www.knowsleysafariexperience.co.uk/tickets
sources.claim: Knowsley Safari adult advance ticket £24.75 (£27.50 same-day), child 3-15 £22.50, toddler 1-2 £2.50, under-1 free.

sources.title: https://www.knowsleysafariexperience.co.uk/plan-your-visit/opening-times
sources.claim: Knowsley Safari is open 10am-5pm daily with last Safari Drive entry at 4pm.

sources.title: https://www.rome2rio.com/s/Aughton/Knowsley-Safari-Park
sources.claim: Knowsley Safari Park is about 13 miles / ~25 minutes by car from Aughton L39.

sources.title: https://www.wwt.org.uk/wetland-centres/martin-mere/plan-your-visit/tickets
sources.claim: WWT Martin Mere online advance adult £17.10, junior 3-17 £11.12, family (2+2) £48.11, under-3s free; on-the-day £19/£12.35/£53.45.

sources.title: https://www.windmillanimalfarm.co.uk/
sources.claim: Windmill Animal Farm in Burscough is open every day 10am-5pm and requires booking in advance.

sources.title: https://www.visitattractions.co.uk/windmill-animal-farm.html
sources.claim: Windmill Animal Farm prices: adults £14.95, children 1-15 £15.95, under-1s free.

sources.title: https://www.farmerteds.com/opening-times
sources.claim: Farmer Ted's Adventure Farm (near Formby/Ormskirk) opens 10:00 daily during the 2026 season with weekends typically 10:00-17:15.

sources.title: https://bookings.farmerteds.com
sources.claim: Farmer Ted's 2026 season runs 12 February to 6 September 2026 with all-inclusive entry covering indoor/outdoor play, animal demonstrations, and toboggan run.

sources.title: https://www.tripadvisor.co.uk/Attraction_Review-g1071013-d2103195-Reviews-Farmer_Teds_Adventure_Farm-Ormskirk_Lancashire_England.html
sources.claim: Farmer Ted's family of 4 paid roughly £33 off-peak; site is geared to toddlers and children up to about 10 with jumping pillows, toboggan run and tractor rides included.

sources.title: https://www.adventurecoastsouthport.co.uk/
sources.claim: Adventure Coast Southport (formerly Pleasureland) has free park entry; unlimited-ride wristbands released daily 11am-12pm at £36.

sources.title: http://www.adventurecoastsouthport.co.uk/your-visit/opening-times/
sources.claim: Adventure Coast Southport opens every weekend 11am-5pm plus daily during school holidays, with pay-per-ride pricing from £1.

sources.title: https://thefamilyholidayguide.co.uk/mattel-play-closes/
sources.claim: Mattel Play! Liverpool permanently closed in June 2020 and is no longer operating.

sources.title: https://www.bubblesworldofplay.co.uk/blog/indoor-play-near-ormskirk-lancashire
sources.claim: Indoor-play options immediately around Aughton/Ormskirk are limited; nearest dedicated centres (Jungle Fun Belle Vale, Flip Out, Otterspool Adventure) sit ~30 minutes south in Liverpool.

sources.title: https://www.westlancs.gov.uk/leisure-recreation/visit-west-lancashire/ormskirk-market.aspx
sources.claim: Ormskirk open-air street market runs each Thursday and Saturday 8am-4.30pm on pedestrianised Moor, Aughton and Church Streets, with up to 100 stalls selling fish, meat, fruit, veg, cheese, bread and pies.

sources.title: https://ormskirk-market.co.uk/
sources.claim: The separate Ormskirk Food & Drink Market is an indoor hall on Moor Street with six street-food traders and a cocktail bar, open Thursday-Sunday with food Sat 10am-9pm.

sources.title: https://burscough-wharf.co.uk/food/
sources.claim: Burscough Wharf, on the Leeds-Liverpool Canal a short drive north of Aughton, hosts independent eateries including Baja Mexican, Cactus Ray's Cafe & Deli, Gurkha Village Bar and Grill, Hugo's Cafe Bar, Milkie Bar, Only Scrans and The Thirsty Duck.

sources.title: https://liverpoolgindistillery.com/pages/contact
sources.claim: Liverpool Gin Distillery on Castle Street offers gin tastings at 4pm and 6.30pm and is open Tue-Thu 12pm-12am and Fri-Sun 12pm-1am; a Gin Tasting Experience runs 1 hour at £38.50pp.

sources.title: https://liverpoolgindistillery.com/pages/about-liverpool-gin-distillery
sources.claim: The distillery spans four floors with a Gin Bar offering 40+ gins and a 600L copper pot still named Margaret producing Liverpool Gin on site.

sources.title: https://www.blacklodgebrewing.co.uk/taproom-1
sources.claim: Black Lodge Brewing in Liverpool's Baltic Triangle runs a taproom on King's Dock Street pouring keg and cask, with resident food trader Fatback Burgers, open four days a week.

sources.title: https://www.southportguide.co.uk/guides/southport-market
sources.claim: Southport Market on Market Street houses nine independent food traders (Tikka Bros, 600 Degrees pizza, Brunch N' Bagel, Pitamu Greek, Cake Corner, Pasta 51, Little Korean Kitchen, Lennys Smashport, Blackhurst Butchers) plus The Market Bar, open Wed-Thu 10am-10pm, Fri-Sat 10am-11pm, Sun 10am-8.30pm.

sources.title: https://www.birkdalecheese.com/about-us/
sources.claim: Birkdale Cheese Co at 42A Liverpool Road, Birkdale, Southport stocks over 150 cheeses and has traded in the village for 40+ years; open Mon-Sat 9-5, closed Sunday.

sources.title: https://www.owdbarn.com/
sources.claim: Owd Barn at Bispham, just outside Ormskirk, is a 16th-century listed barn farm shop with tea room serving farmhouse meals, cakes and fresh fruit pies plus locally-produced meat, fruit and veg.

sources.title: https://theguideliverpool.com/why-we-love-liverpools-bold-street-and-26-places-you-need-to-visit-while-youre-there/
sources.claim: Bold Street in Liverpool is the city's independent dining strip with global cuisines, anchored by Mowgli (Nisha Katona's Indian tiffin spot), Bundobust Indian-vegetarian-and-craft-beer, Maray's Middle Eastern small plates and LEAF teashop.

sources.title: https://www.saltdogslims.com/
sources.claim: Salt Dog Slim's at 79 Seel Street, Liverpool serves American-style chilli dogs in brioche, world beers and steins, open until 2-3am most nights.

sources.title: https://lagombakery.square.site/location
sources.claim: Lagom Bakery on Merlin Park, Ormskirk does sourdough, pastry and specialty coffee; open Wed-Sat 9-3 and Sun 9-1.

sources.title: https://bloomandbrew.co.uk/pages/our-store
sources.claim: Bloom & Brew in Ormskirk is a takeout specialty coffee shop pouring beans from Liverpool roaster Neighbourhood Coffee plus rotating guest roasters, two minutes from Ormskirk station.

sources.title: https://discoverormskirk.com/eat-drink/
sources.claim: The Kicking Donkey near Ormskirk is a contemporary British gastropub praised for fish and chips with a crisp non-oily batter, open fire and reasonable prices.

sources.title: https://independent-liverpool.co.uk/blog/northern-stars-16-reasons-you-need-to-visit-waterloo-and-crosby/
sources.claim: Crosby and Waterloo's St John's Road is lined with independent retailers and restaurants, with Cafe V76, The Little Deli (Buddha bowls with Crosby Coffee), Crosby Coffee Roasters and StoryHouse community café standing out for a foodie detour after Antony Gormley's Another Place on the beach.
